name: alpkit-content-engine
description: ACE: Shopify → local markdown → Shopify pipeline with indexing
summary: Keeps your website content in sync by pulling blog posts and collection pages from Shopify into easy-to-edit markdown files, then packages your changes back into Shopify without needing any API keys. Marketing and content teams can manage and review site content locally, while also getting regular SEO insights and content performance reports. It simplifies content updates and helps spot gaps or opportunities for better scheduling and optimization.
